source_snapshot.procedure: Enable persistence, run level 4, then start service.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Resolve scope; protect live allocations and compare ECC/XID/retirement state.

old_problem: DeepSeek's level 3 omitted level-4-only memory coverage, while the source did not identify allocation impact, live contexts, exact memory plugins or persistent error-state deltas.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA documents `memory` in levels 2-4 and `memtest` in level 4. Source level 4 is therefore authoritative for this GPU-memory row; level 3 cannot replace the additional level-4 memory-pattern coverage.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row362 all 18 XLSX columns and history2957.
Applied official DCGM plugin membership for `memory` and `memtest`.
No GPU memory was allocated, overwritten or tested.

test_case.test_name: DCGM level-4 GPU memory and memtest integrity validation
test_case.purpose: Exercise the source-required memory and level-4 memtest plugins on every selected GPU while proving data integrity and no ECC/XID/retirement/remap regression.
required_package: Pinned DCGM/driver/GPU matrix and reviewed memory-test script/hash or exact config
Expected memory and memtest pattern/subtest manifest
Isolation, thermal/power monitoring and device-recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Drain all selected GPU contexts; preserve logs and capture per-GPU capacity/usage and memory-health state; establish approved DCGM state, run the pinned source-level-4 suite once, retain `memory`, `memtest` and all suite results, recapture health, then restore runtime state.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected memory allocation/integrity/cache and enabled memtest-pattern result passes for every UUID, no test is silently skipped, and no prohibited ECC, XID, retirement, remap, thermal or availability delta occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires both source-applicable memory plugins, complete pattern/subtest accounting and stable persistent health; level 3, a generic PASS or cleared counters cannot substitute.
safety_gate: Workload-owner proof that all target memory is disposable/drained
Stop on integrity/error/device/thermal/power anomaly and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: Final enumeration, runtime and thermal/power health
test_case.recovery: Abort on first integrity or persistent-health fault, quarantine the affected UUID, restore only service/persistence state, verify enumeration through OOB/OS and do not rerun or reset evidence automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Official suite membership establishes source level 4 and its extra memtest coverage over DeepSeek level 3.

blocked.reason: Memory test semantics are defined; exact entities/config and site limits are runtime gates.
